touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Llanelltyd qualifies as a local detour through Ty Fanner; Ty Vanner; Y Faner, Medieval Hallhouse at Cymer Abbey and Llanelltyd Bridge. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.
